info.title: PlotRush account and commerce foundation
info.description: Generated from runtime Zod contracts. Scope: account, order, daily and staff editorial routes. Staff editorial routes require protected roles and a fresh MFA cookie. Payment simulation is local-only. Paystack test checkout, verification and signed webhook acknowledgement are implemented; live billing remains gated.

put.description: Update an existing stable theme. Requires publication switch, fresh MFA and expected revision. Retirement is denied while playable versions reference the theme. Promotion requires three reviewed eligible cases including free solo. IDs remain stable; slug changes use the separate managed rename endpoint.

post.description: Set or remove a logical case's organic featured position (1–100). Requires fresh MFA and expected discovery revision. Setting a pick requires an enabled reviewed release and the publication switch; removing a pick remains available with publishing disabled. Does not change canon or first-publication identity.

get.description: Theme registry with distinct current preview counts under strict catalogue filters. Filters and legacy preferences use slugs; /me/interests uses persisted UUIDs. Retired entries have zero count. Reviewed supply excludes public draft fixtures. Counts/cases use one repeatable-read snapshot; no private player overlay.

200.description: Successful response in the data/meta envelope

get.description: Safe theme, eligible cards and explicitly labelled alternatives under the requested mode/access filters. Conflicting query theme is invalid. Retired API responses are 410 with safe alternative metadata; unknown slugs are 404.

200.description: Successful response in the data/meta envelope

410.description: Retired theme, with error.details.theme and alternatives

/interests.description: Private preview interests use validated stable taxonomy slugs, not UUIDs. Legacy theme-only PUT requests preserve omitted mood/difficulty/opt-out fields. DELETE removes selections and disables personalisation; only a version tombstone remains for stale-write protection. Guest GET returns defaults without creating an identity. PUT can create a guest identity; DELETE requires an existing session.

get.description: Private editorial-preferences-v4 recommendations. Defaults to free solo cases. Scores +3/+2/+1 for theme/mood/difficulty, then first publication descending and stable case UUID. No preferences or opt-out uses eligible publisher featured positions, then newest. Draft fixtures have no invented publication date. Filters and cross-mode/version exposure exclusion remain authoritative; exposedCount counts exposed keys and opt-in replays are separate.
